# <zbk-popover>

An anchored, non-modal overlay for interactive content. The trigger stays in
place before the panel, native popover promotion supplies the top layer where
available, and `open`, `show()`, `hide()`, and `toggle()` are one reflected
visibility contract. Escape, outside press, trigger activation, and keyboard
focus leaving the component dismiss it.

Base class: `.zbk-popover`. Variant classes: `.zbk-popover--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-popover-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- A button reveals forms, links, or other interactive content without blocking the page.
- A compact control panel needs to stay anchored to the control that opened it.
- NOT The content is short supplementary text with no interaction. → zbk-tooltip
- NOT The user must complete or acknowledge a decision before returning to the page. → zbk-dialog
- NOT The content is a command list with menu keyboard semantics. → zbk-menu

## Guidance

- Use one real button or zbk-button in the trigger slot; the component wires the invoker and ARIA relationship.
- Keep interactive content in natural DOM order. Opening does not move focus, so Tab proceeds from the trigger into the panel.
- Escape returns focus to the trigger; outside press and focus leaving the component dismiss without stealing focus.
- Use placement as a preference, not a promise: the panel flips and shifts to stay in the viewport.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the panel is open. Attribute and property changes route through the same native/fallback visibility path. |
| `placement` | `Placement` | `"bottom"` | Preferred floating-ui placement; flip and shift preserve viewport fit. |
| `arrow` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the panel renders a positioned caret. |
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | Interactive panel content such as forms, links, controls, or rich markup. | — |
| `trigger` | The single real button, or component wrapping one, that opens and closes the panel. | required |

- `trigger`: Use button semantics. A role="button" span does not provide the native invoker and keyboard contract.

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space` — The native trigger button opens or closes the popover.
- `Tab / Shift+Tab` — Moves naturally between the trigger, interactive panel content, and the surrounding page; focus is not trapped.
- `Escape` — Closes the popover and returns focus to its trigger.

## Events

No custom events. Native events (`click`, `change`, `input`, ...) bubble from the internal native element in light DOM — listen on the zebkit element.

## Examples

**Filter controls**

```html
<zbk-popover placement="bottom-start"><zbk-button slot="trigger">Filters</zbk-button><form><zbk-checkbox name="available">Available now</zbk-checkbox><zbk-button type="submit">Apply</zbk-button></form></zbk-popover>
```

The form remains non-modal, follows the trigger in tab order, and stays anchored near the control that opened it.

**Popover with an arrow**

```html
<zbk-popover placement="top" arrow><zbk-button slot="trigger">Share</zbk-button><p>Choose who can access this page.</p><zbk-button>Manage access</zbk-button></zbk-popover>
```

The arrow is an optional visual relationship; ARIA and the native invoker relationship do not depend on it.

**Menu semantics on a generic popover** (discouraged)

```html
<zbk-popover><zbk-button slot="trigger">Actions</zbk-button><div role="menu"><button role="menuitem">Archive</button></div></zbk-popover>
```

A generic popover does not implement menu arrow-key navigation, roving tabindex, typeahead, or menu focus placement. Use zbk-menu.

## Tokens (CSS custom properties)

Values are alias references (`{family.name}` compiles to `var(--zbk-family-name)`) or structural literals. Override any of them on a selector to re-style; nothing else is needed.

| Token | Default | Type | Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--zbk-popover-canvas` | `{app.canvas}` | color | — | Popover panel background. |
| `--zbk-popover-ink` | `{app.ink}` | color | — | Popover content color. |
| `--zbk-popover-border-color` | `{app.border}` | color | — | Popover panel border color. |
| `--zbk-popover-border-width` | `{border.width-sm}` | dimension | — | Popover panel border width. |
| `--zbk-popover-border-style` | `{border.style}` | strokeStyle | — | Popover panel border style. |
| `--zbk-popover-border-radius` | `{border.radius-md}` | dimension | — | Popover panel corner radius. |
| `--zbk-popover-padding-inline` | `{spacing.md}` | dimension | — | Inline padding inside the popover panel. |
| `--zbk-popover-padding-block` | `{spacing.sm}` | dimension | — | Block padding inside the popover panel. |
| `--zbk-popover-max-width` | `20rem` | dimension | — | Maximum panel width before content wraps. |
| `--zbk-popover-arrow-size` | `8px` | dimension | — | Arrow square size. |
| `--zbk-popover-offset` | `{popover.arrow-size}` | dimension | — | Gap between the trigger and panel. |
| `--zbk-popover-box-shadow` | `{elevation.md}` | shadow | — | Popover panel shadow. |
| `--zbk-popover-z-index` | `{z-index.popover}` | number | — | Stacking order when native top-layer promotion is unavailable. |
| `--zbk-popover-font-family` | `{font-family.interface}` | fontFamily | — | Popover content font family. |
| `--zbk-popover-font-size` | `{font-size.sm}` | cssDimension | — | Popover content font size. |
| `--zbk-popover-line-height` | `{line-height.2}` | number | — | Popover content line height. |
| `--zbk-popover-opacity` | `1` | number | — | Panel opacity — the property the transition below interpolates. |
| `--zbk-popover-transition-duration` | `{transition.calm-fx-duration-default}` | duration | — | Popover effect transition duration. **(a11y)** |
| `--zbk-popover-transition-timing-function` | `{transition.calm-fx-function-default}` | cubicBezier | — | Popover effect transition timing function. |

## Variants

No shipped variants.

Custom variants: add a `zbk-popover.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "popover": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-popover--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-button>`, `<zbk-tooltip>`, `<zbk-dialog>`.
